help.title: Help & FAQ
help.subtitle: Answers to the questions we hear most

faq.q1: How do I request a damage assessment for my property?
faq.a1: From the home screen, choose New request and select a damage assessment. Add your property details, its location, and a short description. A reconstruction team will review your request and arrange a visit.
faq.q2: Who reviews the cost estimate for my project, and how do I approve it?
faq.a2: After a team surveys your property, they prepare an itemised cost estimate. You will be notified to review the breakdown, and you can approve it with your signature or ask for changes before any work begins.
faq.q3: How is the reconstruction of my property funded?
faq.a3: Approved projects are shared with donors who contribute toward the required amount. You can follow the funding progress for each phase, and funds are released to the team as milestones are confirmed.
faq.q4: How do I follow the progress of my reconstruction?
faq.a4: Open your project to see its current phase, completion percentage, and progress photos. You will also receive a notification each time your team records a new milestone.
faq.q5: What can I do if I have a concern about my reconstruction team?
faq.a5: You can raise a complaint from your project page, describing the matter and selecting the relevant reasons. Our support staff will review it and follow up with you.
faq.q6: How do I confirm that I received funds or that work was completed?
faq.a6: When a disbursement or a handover is ready, you will be asked to confirm receipt and sign. This keeps a clear, transparent record for you, your team, and the donors.
